Associate leverages advanced analytical skills and tools to shape our brand and pricing strategies, ensuring they are aligned with our strategic goals, compliance standards, and customer satisfaction objectives Responsibilities: Functional Responsibilities Perform advanced analytics using Tableau/Power BI and develop predictive models, regression modeling, price elasticity analysis, and promotion optimization to extract actionable insights from data Collaborate on sector NRM strategic projects, such as promotions optimization, terms priorities, competitor benchmarking, and Price Pack Architecture (PPA) initiatives, to drive revenue realization Conduct statistical and trend analysis to identify market opportunities, highlight sector strengths, and provide recommended corrective actions to enhance performance Monitor existing KPI metrics, develop new relevant metrics, and identify correlations and root causes to support data-driven decision-making Design and build visualization dashboards to accelerate information-to-action at scale, enabling easy access to critical insights for various stakeholders Develop programs, methodologies, and reports for analyzing and presenting data, making data-driven insights accessible and actionable Ensure the timely and accurate submission of reports and data to the Revenue Management teams in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA) Improve the utility of operational and performance data within various teams, supporting Business Intelligence (BI), reporting, analysis, and insights efforts Assist the GBS Commercial lead in developing an ongoing training and capability plan for COE associates, ensuring continuous growth and expertise development within the team Qualifications: Key Skills/Experience Required Broader data analysis capabilities. title: Senior Deal Strategy & Operations Analyst
description: About Us: Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com. Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here. Overview: We are seeking a Deal Strategy Analyst to quarterback complex, high-value customer deals for Global and Enterprise accounts in the Technology and Financial Services sectors. This role partners closely with Sales and Customer Success to navigate sophisticated contract negotiations, manage technical and commercial complexities, and ensure successful deal closure while protecting company interests. The ideal candidate will have experience with Salesforce and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), a strong grasp of enterprise deal dynamics, and deep familiarity with complex contract structures common in Technology and Financial Services. This individual will serve as a strategic thought partner to Sales and Customer Success teams—quarterbacking deals from initial requirements through close, navigating intricate commercial and legal requirements, identifying and mitigating risk, and ensuring alignment across Seismic teams while maintaining deal momentum on high-stakes transactions. This role requires a highly organized, strategic, and detail-oriented professional with strong business acumen who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder deal environments. The ideal candidate can manage ambiguity in enterprise negotiations, think strategically about commercial structures, demonstrate sound judgment in navigating nuanced situations, and drive deals forward while managing competing interests across internal and external stakeholders. Who you are:: 5+ years of experience in Deal Strategy, Enterprise Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, or similar roles supporting large, complex customer deals. Extensive hands-on experience with Salesforce and comfort with complex opportunity management. Experience with CPQ tools and end-to-end enterprise sales processes; familiarity with contract-to-cash workflows. Strong understanding of enterprise pricing models, discount structures, and multi-stakeholder approval processes. Ability to review and interpret complex commercial agreements, Statement of Work structures, and technical requirements. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguity and competing interests. Excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and unwavering follow-through on commitments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and collaborate across all organizational levels. Ability to manage multiple complex, concurrent deals with competing demands and tight timelines. Ability to build credibility and influence with Sales leaders, executives, and cross-functional teams; comfortable navigating political and organizational dynamics. Ability to balance adherence to company policies and guidelines with sound judgment, flexibility, and strategic thinking in enterprise deal contexts. Shift timings : 2.30 AM to 11.30 AM shift, time zone aligned to Australian business hours What you'll be doing:: Quarterback enterprise deals from opportunity discovery through contract signature and onboarding, serving as the central coordination point for Sales and Customer Success teams and ensuring alignment with Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations. Lead strategic discussions on deal structure, commercial terms, implementation approach, and pricing models; use Salesforce and CPQ to create comprehensive quotes and proposals that reflect complex, multi-product configurations and sophisticated commercial arrangements. Conduct thorough discovery and due diligence on enterprise opportunities; surface technical, commercial, and contractual requirements early; identify gaps and risks that could impact deal closure. Validate pricing, discount structures, and commercial terms against policy and company risk tolerance; identify non-standard requests and negotiate favorable positions while maintaining strong customer relationships. Lead negotiations on complex commercial structures, including volume tiers, usage-based pricing, multi-year arrangements, professional services bundles, and sector-specific considerations common in Technology and Financial Services. Manage the approval process for large deals, engaging stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Revenue Operations; proactively manage timelines and escalate blockers to leadership to keep deals on track. Drive deal momentum by proactively managing timelines, orchestrating cross-functional collaboration, anticipating obstacles, and maintaining clear communication with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and customers throughout the sales cycle. Identify quoting, pricing, configuration, or workflow issues and bottlenecks; partner with appropriate teams to resolve them and implement streamlined solutions that minimize future manual effort. Escalate strategic issues and complex decisions to Deal Strategy leadership and business stakeholders; contribute business case analysis and recommendations to inform decision-making on high-value opportunities. Serve as the primary interface between Sales, Customer Success, and cross-functional teams (Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, Product); facilitate alignment and resolve conflicts that could jeopardize deal closure. Ensure all deal documentation, commercial terms, contract language, Salesforce data, and approvals are accurate, complete, and properly communicated prior to booking and customer handoff to Customer Success. Manage concurrent large enterprise deals while maintaining focus and attention on each account's unique complexities and strategic importance. Maintain comprehensive and accurate deal records, including commercial terms, contract language, approvals, and contingencies within Salesforce and supporting systems. Identify patterns and best practices in successful enterprise deal closure; share insights and recommendations with the Deal Strategy team to inform process improvements and knowledge-sharing across the function. Support the development and maintenance of Deal Desk playbooks, sector-specific guidance, and best practices for navigating complex Technology and Financial Services deals. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: Associate, Early Careers — Engineering, Global Services & Support
description: Early Careers at SmartDocs: Show Us Who You Are Freshers and final-year students welcome · No experience required · Apply with a 2–3 minute phone video Who we are SmartDocs builds procurement, contract management and spend management software for public sector organizations: state agencies, toll road authorities, cities and utilities. Our customers use our platform to buy goods and services, manage contracts and pay suppliers responsibly with taxpayer money. We work on Java, Angular, SAP integrations and Azure, and we use AI tools every day in how we design, build and support our products. We're hiring a group of early-career people to grow into technical roles with us. We care far more about how you think, learn and communicate than about what's already on your resume. The three tracks We're hiring into three areas. You don't need to have everything figured out. Tell us what interests you, and we'll work out the best fit together. People can and do move between tracks as they grow. 1. Associate Developer You'll learn to build software the way it's increasingly being built: working alongside AI coding agents, reviewing and improving what they produce, and owning features end to end. Good fit if you like building things and want to write code for a living. 2. Global Services Analyst You'll help customers get SmartDocs up and running: understanding how their procurement and finance teams work, configuring the platform, testing, and doing some light development where needed. Good fit if you like technology and people roughly equally, and enjoy solving business problems. 3. Global Support Analyst You'll be the person customers turn to when something isn't working: investigating issues, finding root causes, fixing what you can and working with developers on the rest. Good fit if you like puzzles, are patient, and get satisfaction from making a problem go away. Who should apply Recent graduates or students in your final year of college A degree (or degree in progress) in engineering, computer science, IT, science, maths or a related field. If your degree is something else but you're genuinely technical, apply anyway and tell us why. Curious about how technology works, and willing to learn things nobody has taught you yet Clear communicator in English, spoken and written No work experience is needed. Really. How to apply: send us a 2–3 minute video Instead of a cover letter, we'd like to see and hear from you. Record a short video on your phone introducing yourself. No editing, no fancy setup, no special software. Just you, talking to us. This is not a technical test. We're not going to quiz you on code. We want to get a sense of who you are before we meet you. What to talk about Use these as a guide. You don't need to cover them in order, and you don't need to cover all of them. Who you are. Your name, where you're from, what you studied or are studying. Something you figured out on your own. A project, a problem you solved, something you taught yourself, something you built or fixed. It doesn't have to be technical or impressive. We want to hear how you approached it. Why SmartDocs, and why this kind of work. What draws you to it? Which track interests you most. Or tell us you're not sure yet and what you're weighing. Both are fine answers. One thing we wouldn't learn from your resume. A few tips Keep it between 2 and 3 minutes. Shorter is better than longer. Talk, don't read. Notes are fine, but please don't read from a script, whether you wrote it or an AI did. We want to hear you think. Find a quiet spot with decent light. Face a window rather than having it behind you. Hold your phone steady (propping it up works) and look at the camera. One take is fine. We'd rather see the real you than a polished performance. How to submit Upload your video to hr@smartdocs.ai Name the file: FirstName_LastName_Track.mp4 (for example, Priya_Sharma_Developer.mp4 , or _Undecided if you're not sure) Attach your resume (one page is plenty) Include your graduation year and a phone number we can reach you on What happens next We'll watch every video. If we'd like to take things forward, we'll invite you for a conversation with our team, followed by a short practical exercise based on the track you're interested in. We aim to get back to everyone within asap SmartDocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We're looking forward to meeting you.

description: Early Careers at SmartDocs: Show Us Who You Are Freshers and final-year students welcome · No experience required · Apply with a 2–3 minute phone video Who we are SmartDocs builds procurement, contract management and spend management software for public sector organizations: state agencies, toll road authorities, cities and utilities. Good fit if you like technology and people roughly equally, and enjoy solving business problems. 3. Global Support Analyst You'll be the person customers turn to when something isn't working: investigating issues, finding root causes, fixing what you can and working with developers on the rest. Good fit if you like puzzles, are patient, and get satisfaction from making a problem go away. Who should apply Recent graduates or students in your final year of college A degree (or degree in progress) in engineering, computer science, IT, science, maths or a related field. If your degree is something else but you're genuinely technical, apply anyway and tell us why. Curious about how technology works, and willing to learn things nobody has taught you yet Clear communicator in English, spoken and written No work experience is needed. Really. How to apply: send us a 2–3 minute video Instead of a cover letter, we'd like to see and hear from you. Record a short video on your phone introducing yourself. No editing, no fancy setup, no special software. Just you, talking to us. This is not a technical test. We're not going to quiz you on code. We want to get a sense of who you are before we meet you. What to talk about Use these as a guide. You don't need to cover them in order, and you don't need to cover all of them. Who you are. Your name, where you're from, what you studied or are studying. Something you figured out on your own. A project, a problem you solved, something you taught yourself, something you built or fixed. It doesn't have to be technical or impressive. We want to hear how you approached it. Why SmartDocs, and why this kind of work. What draws you to it? Which track interests you most. Or tell us you're not sure yet and what you're weighing. Both are fine answers. One thing we wouldn't learn from your resume. A few tips Keep it between 2 and 3 minutes. Shorter is better than longer. Talk, don't read. Notes are fine, but please don't read from a script, whether you wrote it or an AI did. We want to hear you think. Find a quiet spot with decent light. Face a window rather than having it behind you. Hold your phone steady (propping it up works) and look at the camera. One take is fine. We'd rather see the real you than a polished performance. How to submit Upload your video to hr@smartdocs.ai Name the file: FirstName_LastName_Track.mp4 (for example, Priya_Sharma_Developer.mp4 , or _Undecided if you're not sure) Attach your resume (one page is plenty) Include your graduation year and a phone number we can reach you on What happens next We'll watch every video. If we'd like to take things forward, we'll invite you for a conversation with our team, followed by a short practical exercise based on the track you're interested in. We aim to get back to everyone within asap SmartDocs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We're looking forward to meeting you.
